title: SEMLOG event catalog
description: JSON document shape accepted by configure(catalog=...). See STANDARDS.md section 5 for the normative prose. This document intentionally uses only a small keyword subset (type, enum, pattern, required, properties, propertyNames, additionalProperties) so it can be checked by a stdlib-only in-test validator.

events.description: Map of declared event names to their description and declared attributes.

attributes.description: Map of declared attribute keys (dotted, flat) to their declared type and optional enum.
